import collections, statistics
cand=[6,10,17,37,57,72,80,87,106,111,114,116]
cs=set(cand)
W=[e for e in events if 43373<=e[2]<=55373]
adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in W: adj[u].append((v,t)); adj[v].append((u,t))
# for all candidate-related triangles, compute closing lag distribution
lags=[]
seen=set()
for a,b,t3 in W:
    ta_map={}
    for x,t in adj[a]:
        if t<t3 and x!=b: ta_map.setdefault(x,[]).append(t)
    for x,t in adj[b]:
        if t<t3 and x!=a and x in ta_map:
            if not(a in cs or b in cs or x in cs): continue
            key=(min(a,b),max(a,b),x)
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key)
            lags.append(t3-max(max(ta_map[x]),t))
lags.sort()
print("cand triangle count:",len(lags))
print("lags<=800:",sum(1 for l in lags if l<=800),"<=2000:",sum(1 for l in lags if l<=2000))
print("median lag:",statistics.median(lags),"deciles:",lags[:5],lags[-5:])
# temporal clustering of the 12 closures
cl=[45271,45284,45398,45838,45860,46518,46916,48928,49100,49522,50816,54185]
print("gaps:",[cl[i+1]-cl[i] for i in range(len(cl)-1)])
# each candidate's own involvement count
print("cand degree in window:", {c:len(adj[c]) for c in cand})
